items.title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
items.summary_1line: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to review product code and support marketing. Its teams also use AI to plan executive dinners and prepare sales updates.
items.editor_note: 출발점: Merge의 코드 리뷰에 GPT-6 Astra와 Codex를 적용한 사례를 다룬 OpenAI 공식 고객 스토리.

items.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
items.summary_1line: Built primarily on OpenAI models, Amplitude’s proactive product agent, Wave, identifies what to build, helps teams ship changes with coding agents, and measures the impact.
items.editor_note: 보조 단계를 넘어 에이전트 루프로 나아간다. Amplitude의 Wave는 무엇을 만들지 직접 정하고, 코딩 에이전트를 통해 배포한 뒤, 그 영향을 측정한다.

items.title: QCon San Francisco 2026: Lessons from Building a $100M Product in Six Weeks at OpenAI
items.summary_1line: At QCon San Francisco 2026, OpenAI's Brian Yang described building the ChatGPT ads product with Codex agents and no human-written code. He outlined layered testing, sandboxes, and batched pull request reviews, and not...
items.editor_note: 벤더 블로그가 아닌 첫 번째 출처로, 사람이 작성한 코드가 전혀 없는 제품에 OpenAI가 직접 적용한 가드레일을 설명한다.

editorial.tldr: This is a theme thread, not one event: three accounts of teams shipping product work with OpenAI models and Codex agents. It opened with two OpenAI customer stories, Merge using GPT-6 Astra and Codex for code review and Amplitude's Wave agent driving 1-2 day product changes.
editorial.whats_new: At QCon SF, OpenAI's Brian Yang said the ChatGPT ads product was built with Codex agents and no human-written code, held together by layered testing, sandboxes, and batched PR reviews.
editorial.why_it_matters: The first engineering account in the thread names the controls behind agent-written code (layered tests, sandboxes, batched review), where the customer stories only named the tools.
editorial.take_for_builders: Before letting coding agents merge unattended, put a sandboxed run and a layered test gate in front of every agent PR, and batch reviews rather than skipping them.

beats.headline: OpenAI customer stories pitch agents across the product loop
beats.summary: Published on OpenAI's own blog: Merge on code review and business tasks, Amplitude on an agent that picks, ships, and measures changes.

beats.headline: QCon SF talk details how OpenAI built ChatGPT ads with Codex agents
beats.summary: An independent InfoQ write-up of a conference talk, with the testing and review process rather than outcome claims.
